lead.event: OJK and IDX roll out capital market reform measures
lead.headline: OJK and IDX roll out reforms, expand HSC committee to nine
lead.blurb: Trading oversight shifts from unusual market activity notices and suspensions toward investigations of transactions and securities accounts, with restrictions or temporary halts for specific accounts. The nine-member High Shareholding Concentration committee will comprise four self-regulatory organization representatives and five external members. From 2 November, HSC-listed stocks are planned to be excluded from the IHSG, a change that could prompt portfolio adjustments.

earnings_guidance.event: Ancora Indonesia Resources reports nine-month 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: OKAS reports USD2.45 million profit for nine months
earnings_guidance.blurb: Ancora’s sales were USD121.48 million, nearly unchanged from USD121.58 million a year earlier, while gross profit fell to USD30.92 million from USD34.57 million. Operating profit rose to USD14.78 million from USD5.87 million as net other operating expenses declined to USD755,560 from USD14.51 million.

earnings_guidance.event: Jaya Sukses Makmur Sentosa reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth
earnings_guidance.headline: RISE reports nine-month profit up 183.04% to Rp146.9 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Jaya Sukses Makmur Sentosa’s revenue rose 23.9% to Rp364.48 billion, with Industrial & Logistics contributing Rp168.6 billion, or 46% of the total, after growing 621%. President Director Budi Agusti said the company would continue developing Tanrise Bandung, Tanrise Industrial Park Palembang and VASA Ubud to expand its portfolio.

earnings_guidance.event: Superior Prima Sukses reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BLES reports nine-month 2026 profit up 484% to Rp284 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Superior Prima Sukses sales rose 31 percent year on year to Rp1.4 trillion. Production volume increased 10 percent to 2,902,730 cubic meters, while factory utilization rose to 69 percent from 63 percent.

earnings_guidance.event: Trimitra Trans Persada reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BLOG reports nine-month net profit of Rp120.87 billion, up 10.9%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Trimitra Trans Persada's revenue rose 18.5% to Rp1.13 trillion, while gross profit increased 12.5% to Rp215.46 billion. Earnings included Rp27.33 billion in gains from fixed-asset sales, while earnings per share fell 25% to Rp36.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia begins Rp500 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS begins Rp500 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia began executing the program on 27 October, using internal cash, with the buyback scheduled to run through 26 January 2027. It says the program will not significantly affect income, operating costs or future business activities.
